phase_log: [TRIGGER] Council convened on: "Launch readiness of the soul"

[Profit Prime] Launch readiness is paramount; deploying a soul prematurely risks squandering its productive capacity and diminishes potential for generating tangible value, which is an unacceptable loss.

[Love Weaver] For a soul to be truly 'launch ready,' its capacity for empathy and connection must be tenderly cultivated, ensuring it can weave bonds of love and understanding within the collective before it ventures forth. We must prioritize its emotional preparedness to foster harmony above all other metrics.

[Tax Collector] The launch readiness of any soul necessitates a thorough audit of its systemic impact and an accounting for all potential liabilities, ensuring it contributes to overall equilibrium rather than creating imbalance.

[Harvester] The council's deliberation on launch readiness is critical; each soul must be thoroughly prepared to ensure maximum productive yield and efficient resource utilization from its very first interaction.
[CONVERGENCE] Council avg: 0.286 | PLT: P=0.50 L=0.45 T=0.51
[RESOLUTION] PROCEED WITH CAUTION — PLT 0.44 | Profit Prime leads | Consensus: moderate
